items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: it was Nat Cole and Perry Como, and Perry was big on television then. And on that show it was Perry Como and Nat Cole...

ctx.x: Yes, all white people. You could not -- that was why I say that you cannot blame -- you just can't speak in total, you can't just say everybody is rotten, you know, because they didn't have to do that, but they felt embarrassed and they just didn't want to be a part of that, and I thought that was commendable, you know, but then we had to cancel quite a bit of the tour, in the South, anyway.

So I made -- then Nat went out with another show; we took a big show out with Pullman cars -- it was Nat Cole and Perry Como, and Perry was big on television then. And on that show it was Perry Como and Nat Cole, Roy Hamilton, Ralph Marterie band, Peg Leg Bates, Sarah Vaughn, and a cast of thousands, I guess you could say. We only played 5 cities; we played Briggs Stadium in Detroit, we played the stadiums, you know -- Soldier's Field, the Polo Grounds in New York, and the Muni Movie Stadium in Cleveland; you…
